input.quote: On request or termination, the recipient shall return or destroy Confidential Information, subject to routine backups and legal retention. Duties for trade secrets continue while protected as trade secrets; duties for other Confidential Information continue for five years after disclosure. Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15.
input.rationale: This hosted-services MSA contains no post-termination transition-assistance or data-return obligation. Section 10.1 merely assumes "any agreed transition period" without creating a right to one, and Section 10.2 covers only Deliverables and refunds. Section 16.5's return-or-destroy duty expressly carves Customer Data out to "Sections 11 and 15" — there is no Section 11 in the Agreement, and Section 15 addresses only processing restrictions and privacy compliance, not return, export format, or deletion timing. Neither the preferred nor the fallback position (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days) is met, so we insert a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, machine-readable return of Customer Data within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter (with the customary backup/legal-retention carve-out already used in Section 16.5). Ninety days' assistance is available as a fallback.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards. The Agreement currently has no data-return or exit-assistance obligation (Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, neither of which addresses return or deletion), and we cannot migrate off a hosted service without it. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion.
